notes: Three linked raster-output competencies under one scenario. The agent must author and compile a compact C ray tracer (ray-sphere intersection, lambert+phong materials, one reflection bounce, shadow rays) that re-derives a target color render and a depth/color raster from scene data rather than reading a reference; the verifier recompiles ptrace.c and re-renders it, then compares against goldens with strict SSIM/density tolerances plus a compressed source-size ceiling, so an overfitting agent that embeds the golden bytes fails the budget and wrong shading/geometry fails the SSIM bar (hard). Debugging ambiguity is high because there is no numeric output to copy: the agent must get the ray/camera/lighting math, the PFM/PGM/PPM binary formats (row order, endian, headers) and full determinism exactly right to match reference thresholds. Complementary easy floor (PNG icon, byte-identical regeneration, parsing canvas size and fallbacks, rendering edge/malformed hidden scenes at correct size) is exercised too; the fixed-scene exact-golden checks are the hard gate.
